newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NWDC sells Yabeng stake for 154 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: NWDC sells Yabeng stake for 154 mln rand.

text.p: The North West Development Corp Ltd said on Wednesday Bophirima Investment Holding Co Ltd would buy its 40.2 percent stake in Yabeng Investment Holding Co Ltd at 545 cents per share amounting, to 153.7 million rand.
The deal is subject to approval and finalisation of a funding structure.
Yabeng urged shareholders to continue exercising caution in their dealings after the announcement pending a further announcement.

It also referred shareholders to an earlier cautionary that it was in talks with Choice Holdings Ltd which could impact on its share price. Yabeng holds 39.12 percent of the Choice preference share capital, an effective 19.56 percent of Choice's issued share capital.
